ऊ: ऊ 1. ऊ, the sixth letter of the alphabet, corresponding to उ long, and having the sound of that letter in the word रुले. —ऊ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ऊ।
ऊ 2. ऊ, ind. an interjection of compassion, of regard; an incipient particle used at the beginning of a sentence.
ऊ 3. ऊ, ऊस्, m. the moon; epithet of Śiva.
ऊत: 1. ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, favoured, preserved, promoted, loved.
ऊत 2. ऊत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वे), woven.
ऊत, ऊति। See s. v., p. 177.
ऊति: 1. ऊति, इस्, f. favouring, protecting, promoting, aid, assistance, help, favour, kindness, friendly feeling, affec-tion, wish, desire, striving after, hastening towards, delight, enjoyment, sport, play, distillation; (अयस्), pl. objects of enjoyment, as food &c.
ऊम: ऊम, अस्, m., Ved. a good friend, an affectionate companion, an intimate associate; (अम्), n., N. of a town or country.
ऊअट: ऊअट ऊअट, a various reading for उवट, q. v.
ऊठ्: ऊठ् ऊठ्, a various reading for उठ्, q. v.
ऊढ: ऊढ 1. ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वह् or 1. ऊह्, for 2. ऊढ see 2. ऊह्), carried as a load or burden; married; (आ), f. a bride, a wife espoused according to the ritual. —ऊढ-कङ्कट, अस्, आ, अम्, armed, mailed. —ऊढ-भार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has married a wife. —ऊढ-वयस्, आस्, m. a young man.
2. ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, observed, inferred, &c.
ऊढय: ऊढय, nom. (fr. ऊढ or ऊढि) P. ऊढयति, aor. औजढत् or औजिढत्, or औडिढत्, to carry (?).
ऊणीतेजस्: ऊणीतेजस् ऊणी-तेजस्, आस्, m., N. of a Buddha; (a various reading has ऊर्णीतेजस्।)
ऊधन्: ऊधन् ऊधन् and उधर्, forms used in the Veda for some of the cases of ऊधस् below.
ऊधस्: ऊधस् ऊधस्, n. (said to be fr. rt. वह्। In the Veda the forms ऊधर् and ऊधन् are used for some of the cases, e. g. sing. nom. ऊधर्, gen. abl. ऊध्नस्, loc. ऊधन् or ऊधनि; pl. inst. ऊधभिस्, loc. ऊधस्सु), an udder; a covered secret place where only friends are admitted; the bosom; the breast of a mother; the udder of the sky, i. e. the clouds. In classical Sanskrit the form ऊधन् appears only in the fem. of adjective compounds, cf. अध्य्-ऊध्नी, कुण्डोध्नी, घटोध्नी, पीनोध्नी; [cf. Gr. οὖθαρ Lat. uber; Germ. ûtar, euter; Angl. Sax. uder; Eng. udder; Hib. uit, uitche.] —ऊधस्-वती, f. having a full udder.
ऊधन्य: ऊधन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from the udder; (अम्), n. milk.
ऊधस्य: ऊधस्य, अम्, n. milk, ‘produced from the udder.’
ऊन: ऊन ऊन, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. अव् and opposed to पूर्ण, अति-रिक्त, अधिक), wanting, de-ficient, defective, short of any quantity, less than the right number, not sufficient; less (in number, size, or degree), minus, fewer, smaller, inferior, &c. (e. g. ऊन-द्विवर्ष, not quite two years old; द्वाभ्याम् ऊन, less by two; अल्पोन, ‘less by a little,’ ‘a little less.’ Prefixed to any even decimal numeral from twenty up to a hundred, ऊन serves to denote one less than the even ten, e. g. ऊन-विंशति, twenty minus one or nineteen; ऊन-त्रिंशत्, thirty minus one; ऊनत्रिंश, the thirtieth minus one or twenty-ninth: so also with other numerals prefixed, e. g. पञ्चोन-त्रिंशत्, thirty minus five or twenty-five; एकोनचत्वारिंश, the fortieth minus one or thirty-ninth.)
ऊनक: ऊनक, अस्, आ, अम्, not sufficient, less, inferior.
ऊनय: ऊनय, nom. P. ऊनयति, -यितुम्, to leave defi-cient or unfinished; to deduct or lessen; to mete out in small quantities; to measure.
ऊनित: ऊनित, अस्, आ, अम्, lessened by subtraction or deduc-tion, less, fewer, &c.
ऊम्: ऊम् ऊम्, ind. an interjection of interroga-tion; of anger; of reproach, abuse, envy, and arro-gance.
ऊय्: ऊय् ऊय्, cl. 1. A. ऊयते = वे, वयति, to weave, sew.
ऊररी: ऊररी ऊररी, ind. a particle of assent and diffusion; ऊररी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, allowed, promised. See उररी।
ऊरी: ऊरी, ind. = ऊररी; see उरी. —ऊरी-कृत्य, ind. having promised, agreed, assented to.
ऊरु: ऊरु ऊरु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. ऊर्णु), the thigh; N. of a son of Manu Cākṣuṣa; (वी), f. the middle of the thigh or a principal vein situated there. When ऊरु is used at the end of a compound the fem. form may end in either short or long उ, but more properly in the latter (e. g. वामोरुस् or वामो-रूस्, a beautiful-thighed woman; रम्भोरु and वरोरु, O beautiful-thighed one; voc. cases of वरोरू and रम्भोरू). —ऊरु-ग्लानि, इस्, f. weakness of the thigh. —ऊरु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from the thigh; (अस्), m. a Vaiśya. —ऊरु-दघ्न or ऊरु-द्वयस or ऊरु-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, reaching to the thighs, as high as the thighs. —ऊरु-पर्वन्, आ or अ, m. n. the knee. —ऊरु-फलक, अम्, n. the thigh-bone, the hip-bone. —ऊरु-भिन्न, अस्, ई, अम्, having a rent in the thigh (according to Pāṇini IV. 1, 52, used as a Bahu-vrīhi). —ऊरु-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from the thigh. —ऊरु-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. paralysis of the lower extremities, rheumatism of the thigh; (आ), f. the plantain tree. —ऊरूद्भव (ऊरु-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from the thigh. —ऊरु-अष्ठीव, अम्, n. thigh and knee.
ऊरव्य: ऊरव्य, अस्, m. a man of the third or Vaiśya tribe as born from the thighs of Brahmā.
ऊरुरी: ऊरुरी ऊरुरी, ind. a particle implying as-sent, admission, promise, diffusion, &c.; [cf. ऊररी।]
ऊर्ज्: ऊर्ज् ऊर्ज्, क्, f. (fr. rt. वृज्; cf. Eng. work), food, strength, vigour, sap, juice; often occurring in conjunction with इष् (e. g. इषम् ऊर्जम् अश्युः, ‘may they obtain food and strength’); [cf. Gr. ὀργάω and ὀργάς Lat. urgeo; Hib. orc, ‘a prince, a hero;’ orcaim, ‘I kill, I destroy.’]
ऊर्ज: ऊर्ज, अस्, m., N. of the month Kārttika, i. e. November-December (as imparting food or strength); power, strength; effort, exertion; procreative power; life, breath; N. of a son of the second Manu; of Satyahita; of Vatsara; of the sons of Hiraṇya-garbha who are reckoned among the seven Ṛṣis of the third Manvantara; (आ), f. food, strength, sap; N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Vasiṣṭha; (अम्), n. water. —ऊर्ज-योनि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Viśvā-mitra. —ऊर्ज-वाह, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śuci. —ऊर्ज-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. granting strength. —ऊर्ज-स्तम्भ, अस्, m., N. of one of the seven Ṛṣis of the second Manvantara. —ऊर्जाद् (°जा-अद्), त्, त्, त्, Ved. an eater of strengthening food. —ऊर्जा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, abounding in food. —ऊर्जाहुति (°जा-आह्°), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. offering nourishing or strength-giving sacrifices.
ऊर्जय: ऊर्जय, nom. P. ऊर्जयति, -यितुम्, to feed, strengthen; A. to become strong, to be powerful.
ऊर्जयत्: ऊर्जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. strong, full of sap or juice, succulent; feeding, strengthening, nourishing.
ऊर्जव्य: ऊर्जव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abounding in food or strength.
ऊर्जस्: ऊर्जस्, a form for ऊर्ज्, used in compounds and with affixes, thus ऊर्जस्-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, causing strength. —ऊर्जस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, rich in food, abounding in sap or juice, juicy, succulent, powerful, vigorous, robust, strong; (ती), f., N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Dharma; of a daughter of Priya-vrata and wife of Uśanas; wife of Prāṇa. —ऊर्जस्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, powerful. —ऊर्जस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, strong, powerful; (इ), n. a figure of rhetoric, speak-ing of anything with disdain.
ऊर्जित: ऊर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, powerful, strong, mighty, great, excellent, exceeding, much; (अस्), m., N. of a prince. —ऊर्जिताश्रय (°त-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, spirited, mag-nanimous.
ऊर्जिन्: ऊर्जिन्, ई, इनी, इ, abounding in food.
ऊर्ण: ऊर्ण ऊर्ण, अम्, आ, n. f. (fr. rt. वृ, to cover, and connected with rt. ऊर्णु next col.), wool; (आ), f. a circle of hair between the eyebrows; N. of the wife of Citra-ratha and mother of Samrāj; [cf. Lat. villus, vellus; Goth. vulla; Old Germ. wolla; Mod. Germ. ऊर्णायु: ऊर्णायु, उस्, उस्, उ, woollen; (उस्), m. a ram; a woollen blanket; a spider; N. of a Gandharva.
ऊर्णु: ऊर्णु ऊर्णु (connected with rt. वृ), cl. 2. P. ऊर्द्: ऊर्द् ऊर्द्, a various reading for rt. उर्द्, q. v.
ऊर्दर: ऊर्दर ऊर्दर, अस्, m. (said to be in some of its meanings fr. ऊर्ज् and rt. दॄ), Ved. a vessel for measuring corn, a bushel; a hero, a champion; a Rakṣas, a goblin or fiend.
ऊर्ध: ऊर्ध ऊर्ध and ऊर्धक, a wrong reading for ऊर्ध्व and ऊर्ध्वक।
ऊर्ध्व: ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्व, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वृध्), rising upwards, tending upwards, raised, elevated, erected, erect, upright; being above; above, high, superior, upper. (अम्), n. elevation, height, any-thing situated above; (अम्), ind. upwards, towards the upper part, aloft, above, in the upper regions, on the upper side of (with abl.); in the sequel (as of a book, the upper leaves of a MS. being read last); subsequent, after (with abl.); in a high tone, aloud; ऊर्ध्वं द्वितीयाद् अचः, after the second vowel; ऊर्ध्वम् पितुः, after the father's death; संवत्-सराद् ऊर्ध्वम्, after a year; अत ऊर्ध्वम्, hence-forward, from that time forward, hereafter; ऊर्ध्वं गम्, to go upwards, to die; [cf. epithet of Śiva. —ऊर्ध्व-शोधन, अम्, n. ‘purifying upwards,’ i. e. vomiting. —ऊर्ध्व-शो-षम्, ind. so as to dry (anything) above. —ऊर्ध्व-श्वास, अस्, m. expiration. —ऊर्ध्व-सानु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. carrying the neck high, with lofty or uplifted neck; (Sāy.) rising higher and higher. —ऊर्ध्व-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being above, superior, situated on high. —ऊर्ध्व-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, being or standing above. —ऊर्ध्व-स्थिति, इस्, f. the rearing of a horse; a horse's back, the part where the rider sits; eleva-tion, superiority. —ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, N. of a creation of beings whose stream of life or current of nutriment tends upwards. —ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुलि (°व-अङ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, with raised finger. —ऊर्ध्वाम्नाय-संहिता (°व-आम्°), f. the doctrines of a particular Vaiṣṇava sect. —ऊर्ध्वायन (°व-अय्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a caste in Plaksha-dvīpa. —ऊर्ध्वावर्त (°व-आव्°), अस्, m. rearing of a horse. —ऊर्ध्वासित (°व-आस्°), अस्, m. the plant Momordica Charantia. —ऊर्ध्वेह (°व-ईह), अस्, m. motion or tendency upwards.
ऊर्ध्वक: ऊर्ध्वक अस्, m. a kind of drum.
ऊर्ध्वसान: ऊर्ध्वसान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. rising, erecting one's self.
ऊर्ध्वीकृ: ऊर्ध्वी-कृ, cl. 5. 8. P. A. -कृणोति, -णुते, -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to raise aloft, to elevate.
ऊर्मि: ऊर्मि ऊर्मि, इस्, m. f. (fr. rt. वृ), a wave; a current, the flowing of water; human infirmity (as grief, illusion, hunger, thirst, decay, death); speed, velocity; a fold or plait in a garment; a line, a row; manifestation, light; mental suffering, distress, un-easiness, pain; missing, regretting; association, num-ber, quantity; [cf. Lith. wilni-s; Old Germ. wella; Mod. Germ. Welle; Eng. well.] —ऊर्मि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, wavy, undulating, billowy; crooked; plaited, curled (as hair). —ऊर्मिमत्-ता, f. undulation; crook-edness. —ऊर्मिमालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wreathed with waves, adorned with waves; (ई), m. the ocean.
ऊर्मिका: ऊर्मिका, f. a wave; a plait or fold in a garment; a finger ring; regret, sorrowing for anything lost; the buzzing of a bee.
ऊर्मिन्: ऊर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. having waves, undulating.
ऊर्मिला: ऊर्मिला, f., N. of a daughter of Janaka and wife of Lakṣmaṇa, mother of Gandharvī Somadā.
ऊर्म्य: ऊर्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. undulating, having waves, agitated; (आ), f. night.
ऊर्व: ऊर्व 1. ऊर्व, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वृ), Ved. a re-ceptacle (for water), a reservoir; a cloud; an enclosed place, a stable for cattle; a prison, captivity (?); an epithet of the Pitṛs or manes of deceased ancestors.
ऊर्व 2. ऊर्व, अस्, m. (fr. ऊरु ?), N. of a saint from whose thighs sprang Aurva, a fiery being received by the ocean; the submarine fire; N. of a prince.
ऊर्व्य: ऊर्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in reservoirs, lakes, &c.
ऊर्वरा: ऊर्वरा ऊर्वरा, f. fertile soil, land bearing any and every crop. See उर्वरा।
ऊर्वशी: ऊर्वशी ऊर्वशी, f., N. of an Apsaras. See उर्वशी।
ऊर्व्यङ्ग: ऊर्व्यङ्ग ऊर्व्यङ्ग, अम्, n. (said to be fr. ऊर्वी = उर्वी, ‘earth,’ and अङ्ग), a mushroom.
ऊर्षा: ऊर्षा ऊर्षा, f. a kind of grass, Andropogon Serratum.
ऊलुपिन्: ऊलुपिन् ऊलुपिन्, ई, m. a porpoise. See उलुपिन्।
ऊलूक: ऊलूक ऊलूक, अस्, m. an owl. See उलूक।
ऊवट: ऊवट ऊवट, a various reading for उवट and ऊअट, q. v.
ऊवध्य: ऊवध्य ऊवध्य or ऊबध्य, अम्, n., Ved. undigested grass &c. in the stomach (of an animal).
ऊष्: ऊष् ऊष्, cl. 1. P. ऊषति, -षितुम्, to be diseased or disordered, to be sick or ill.
ऊष: ऊष ऊष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. उष् or fr. ऊष् above ?), salt ground, soil impregnated with saline par-ticles; a cleft, a hole; the cavity of the ear; dawn, day-break (in the latter sense neut. according to some); the mountain Malaya; (ई), f. soil impregnated with saline particles or not fertile. —ऊष-पुट, अम्, n. particles of salt wrapped up in paper. —ऊष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, consisting of saline soil.
ऊषक: ऊषक, अम्, n. salt, pepper; dawn, day-break.
ऊषण: ऊषण, अम्, n. black pepper; (आ), f. long pepper.
ऊषर: ऊषर, अस्, आ, अम्, impregnated with salt; (अम्), n. a barren spot with saline soil. —ऊषर-ज, अम्, n. salt produced from salt soil; a kind of magnet.
ऊषा: ऊषा ऊषा, f., N. of the wife of Aniruddha. See उषस्, &c.
ऊष्मन्: ऊष्मन् ऊष्मन्, आ, m. (fr. rt. 1. उष्), heat, steam, vapour, exhalation; ardour, passion, violence; the hot season; (in gram.) the sounds श्, ष्, स्, ह्; ष्क्, ष्प्, अं, अः, and more especially the first four of these sounds. —ऊष्म-प, अस्, आ, अम्, imbibing the steam of hot food; (आस्), m. pl. a class of manes or deceased ancestors; (अस्), m. fire. —ऊष्म-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, followed by an Ūṣman. —ऊष्म-प्रकृति, इस्, इस्, इ, produced from an Ūṣman. —ऊष्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, hot, steaming. —ऊष्मान्त (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ending in an Ūṣman. —ऊष्मान्तःस्थ (°म-अन्°), आस्, m. pl. the sounds called Ūṣman and the semivowels. —ऊष्मोपगम (°म-उप्°), अस्, m. the approach of the heat.
ऊष्मण: ऊष्मण or ऊष्मण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. steaming.
ऊष्माय: ऊष्माय, nom. A. ऊष्मायते, -यितुम्, to emit heat or steam, to steam, perspire.
ऊह्: ऊह् 1. ऊह्, cl. 1. P. (with prep. also A.) ऊहति, -ते, औहीत्, ऊहितुम्, to change, modify; (with prep.) to push, thrust, move, remove, touch lightly. (This root is connected with rt. वह्; and it is often difficult to decide to which of these two roots forms like 1. ऊढ, p. 177, are to be assigned.)

ऊह् 2. ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. ऊहति, -ते (Ved. ओहते), ऊहे and ऊहाञ्-चक्रे, ऊहिष्यते, औहिष्ट, ऊहितुम्, to observe, mark, note, attend to (with acc.): to reckon on (with loc.); to wait for; to comprehend, conceive, conjecture, suppose, infer, reason, deliberate about; to be regarded as: Caus. ऊहयति, -यितुम्, aor. औजिहत्, to cause to think, reason, infer, or conjecture; to attend to (?); to do, accomplish (?): Desid. ऊजिहिषते; [cf. Hib. uige; Lat. äugeo; Goth. auka; Hib. ugtar, ‘augmentation.’]
ऊह: 1. ऊह, अस्, m. change, modification. —ऊह-गान, अम्, n. or ऊह-गीति, इस्, f., N. of the third Gāna or song book of the Sāma-veda.
2. ऊह, अस्, m. deliberation, examination; reason-ing; understanding; completing a defective sentence or verse, supplying an ellipsis; [cf. Hib. uga, ‘choice, election.’]
ऊह्यगान: ऊह्य-गान, अम्, n., N. of the fourth Gāna or song book of the Sāma-veda.
ऊहन: ऊहन, अम्, n. reasoning, inferring, concluding.
ऊहिन्: ऊहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, who or what reasons; who or what assembles, infers, or conjectures; (इनी), f. an assemblage, a collection; arrangement, a multitude reduced to order; [cf. अक्षौहिणी।]
ऊह्य: ऊह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, inferrible, to be investigated, requiring to be supplied, elliptical.
